deployments_detail.use: AI to optimize CO2 injection into aging Permian oilfields (enhanced oil recovery + carbon capture/DAC Stratos)

Automated review and classification of ~1.5 million land-lease/mineral-rights agreements: PDFs are OCR'd and an LLM classifies each document into one of 140 categories and extracts key metadata (dates, legal terms), replacing a planned 30-contractor manual effort. [MongoDB Atlas + Microsoft Azure AI Document Intelligence (OCR) + off-the-shelf LLM + AWS Lambda/S3]
deployments_detail.value: $4 million and 12 months saved vs. manual plan; 1.5M documents processed; ~$3M additional anticipated savings

deployments_detail.use: Enterprise cloud + analytics/ML platform: Occidental selected AWS as preferred cloud provider, using AWS Lake Formation and machine learning to break down data silos, improve exploration decision-making times and optimize equipment performance; subsidiary 1PointFive analyzes real-time direct-air-capture performance data to optimize equipment efficiency. [Amazon Web Services (Lake Formation, EC2, EBS)]

In-house AI-built digital twins of oilfields that ingest millions of datapoints from thousands of sensors to design and simulate more effective CO2 injection / enhanced oil recovery strategies in the Permian Basin. [In-house (unnamed)]

AI/ML-based predictive maintenance across oilfield operations: real-time sensor data feeds self-learning predictive models to forecast and mitigate unplanned equipment failures/events, with robots and drones performing inspection tasks. [In-house / IoT + ML (unnamed)]

Oxy Drilling Dynamics: proprietary physics-based drilling optimization combined with machine learning and advanced optimization algorithms to reduce inefficient rig energy, improve drilling rates and lower well costs in conventional and unconventional operations. [In-house (Oxy Drilling Dynamics)]

Enterprise-wide deployment of agentic AI in an asset-heavy business, spanning safety monitoring, predictive maintenance and automated machine control, described by Oxy's Chief of AI as disciplined production rollout rather than model hype. [Not specified]

Explainable machine learning for hydrocarbon prospect risk assessment: Oxy geophysical experts apply ML models with model-agnostic explanation (LIME) to seismic and geometry data to risk drilled prospects in exploration. [In-house (Oxy geophysics team); LIME explainability]

SensorUp Gas Emissions Management Solution (GEMS): AI aggregates and analyzes methane emission data from satellites, aerial imagery, IoT sensors, optical gas imaging and drones to establish the source, cause, time and rate of real-time emissions, accelerating leak detection and repair. [SensorUp (GEMS) on AWS (IoT Core, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, AppSync, ECS)]
